adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, the diff introduces `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and uses it directly in `group.users...limit(limit)` with no upper bound or clamping. This enables a client to request an arbitrarily large `limit`, potentially causing excessive DB/load (minor DoS). The change also expands pagination (and thus the unbounded `limit`) from only automatic groups previously to all groups.
